name: Solenne NeuroConductor Aug-Interface Suit
description: Second-skin bodysuit in deep graphite with hair-fine silver trace lines mapping the body's full aug-interface topology — power routing, data bus channels, neural handshake nodes — all printed directly into the fabric via nano-deposition. At the Spire, chrome is architectural, not just functional, and this suit ensures every implant communicates at peak fidelity. The fabric itself is a nano-woven thermal regulator: cool when you're warm, warm when you're cold, imperceptibly thin. Worn alone, the silver traces catch light like circuit diagrams. Under anything else, it's invisible infrastructure.
functionality: Full-body power and data routing between chrome implants and BCI systems; thermal self-regulation across a 15-degree ambient range; electromagnetic shielding against passive signal intercept; nano-trace channels adapt to new implant configurations via BCI-paired recalibration.
what_it_says: Your augmentations are not accommodated — they are orchestrated.
worn_by: elite operatives whose chrome requires coordinated management
story_hooks: A Solenne suit recovered from a corporate assassination scene still holds cached signal data in its trace network — a ghost record of the wearer's final BCI transmissions.
A Tier 3 tech who works Solenne quality control has been quietly building a counterfeit version from stolen nano-deposition specs — it's almost right, and almost right is dangerous.
The suit's EM shielding is blocking something its wearer didn't authorize — someone installed a passive intercept layer during the last fitting appointment.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting second-skin bodysuit that hugs the body like a liquid shadow. The graphite base reads as nearly black under most lighting, but silver traces create a luminous circuit-board pattern across the entire torso, limbs, and neck. Worn alone, it appears as a high-tech athletic layer; layered beneath other garments, only glimpses of silver geometry peek through at seams and collar. The silhouette is impossibly smooth—no bulk, no breaks, pure anatomical precision.
physical_description.fit: Second-skin compression fit. Contours every curve and contour of the body without restriction. Articulated at shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees for full mobility. So form-fitting it appears printed onto skin rather than worn over it.
physical_description.primary_material: Nano-woven synthetic composite with embedded nano-deposition silver trace lines. Thermal-regulating matrix that responds dynamically to body temperature and ambient conditions. Gossamer-thin but durable.
physical_description.texture: Impossibly smooth to the touch with a subtle moisture-wicking sheen. The silver traces are flush with the surface—not raised, not embroidered—creating only the faintest texture variation detectable by fingertip. The fabric itself feels like cool silk against skin.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep graphite (near-black) base with hair-fine silver circuit traces forming node-clusters, bus-line highways, and branching neural pathways. Under direct light, the pattern reads as three-dimensional topology. In shadow, nearly invisible.
physical_description.closures: None. Full-body pull-on design. Friction-fit at wrists and ankles for security. No visible seams except at functional joints.
distinctive_features: Nano-deposition silver trace topology mapping full aug-interface routing
Neural handshake node markers at standard implant sites (temples, spine, shoulders, wrists)
Power-routing pathways glowing faintly under UV light
Seamless construction except at articulation points
Solenne Atelier maker's mark (minimal, etched in silver at nape of neck)
Dynamic color-shift in certain lighting conditions
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 exclusive / Tier 1 elite augmentation infrastructure. Worn by the most extensively modded operatives in the GLMZ—corpo net-runners, military conversion specialists, independent chrome artists. The price point is Φ 8,000–14,000.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is not street wear. It's augmentation couture. Wearing this signals deep chrome commitment, serious neural integration, and access to Solenne's white-list clientele. Among the modded elite, it's a status piece that says 'my augmentations are not afterthought—they're architecture.' In corpo circles, it's worn under formal datasuits. On the street, it announces a serious player.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but develops subtle wear patterns: fading of silver traces at high-friction points (elbows, knees, neck), minor micro-scratches in the graphite base that catch light. Weathered examples show silver oxidation at the edges, creating an aged patina. Never damaged—nano-weave is self-repairing at microscopic levels.

image_prompt: High-fashion cyberpunk bodysuit photography: Model in deep graphite second-skin suit with luminous silver circuit-board tracery mapping across torso, arms, and neck. Pose mid-stretch or turning to catch light on the silver traces. Dark moody lighting with cool blue accent light raking across the suit's surface to highlight the nano-deposited pathway details. Minimal background—charcoal or black—with subtle corporate architecture or data-stream holo-elements bleeding in at edges. Close detail shot of the nape showing Solenne maker's mark. The suit should read as liquid, anatomical, almost invisible until light hits the silver. Cinematic, cold, elite. --ar 2:3 --v 6
